notes.title: Small patch fixing possible issue with Angelica's fight
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Some time ago, some users reported an issue with one of the boss fights, Angelica's, but we weren't able to reproduce it. We didn't have enough information to look for the possible cause, so we couldn't solve it. But recently, another user (thanks a lot for  your help, Ice_Vogel!) who experienced the same issue provided some further information to us and we were able to find and solve the problem.

Probably you never experienced the error, which bugged the honey burst from the flower patches in the third stage of Angelica's fight, which didn't appear, so not being able to win the battle. But in case you experienced it, now is solved.

And that's it. Thanks a lot for your continued support!

notes.title: CLeM Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It’s been almost 2 years since we revealed CLeM, the fourth game in the Psychotic Adventures series, to the world. Now, we're thrilled to announce that the game is set to release on February 6th, 2024! 

To mark this occasion, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer that’ll take you into the mystical world of CLeM! Check it out!

[previewyoutube=BuiYImHSR9o;full]https://youtu.be/BuiYImHSR9o[/previewyoutube]

We’ve also decided on a price point for the game: $15.99. In addition, we’ll be adding a 10% discount on launch day!

We want to send a massive, heartfelt thank you to all those who’ve been following and supporting CLeM up to this point! As we close in on the crucial release phase that will determine CLeM's success, we invite you to join our Discord and contribute to making it as successful as possible!

We hope that you are as excited about the imminent release of CLeM as we are! 

Wishlist the game now!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861440/CLeM/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 adds Catalan localisation and fixes some gameplay issues
notes.notes:
Hello, destroyers.

With this new patch 1.0.4 we have tweaked some gameplay features so you can feel more powerful since the beginning of your mission. We have also added Catalan localisation, so now the game can be played in English, Spanish, Korean, Russian and Catalan.

Aaaaaaand, that's it. Best of luck in your destruction quest!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 adds useful tips and gameplay improvements
notes.notes:
Hello, destroyers.

This new patch 1.0.3 adds some tips to loading screens that we are sure you will find really useful in the battleground. The update also includes some nice gameplay improvements, so now your combos won't be interrupted after healing or blocking, and some puzzles in Neon District will be easier to understand thanks to some visual and input modifications. 

We hope these changes make the game a better experience for you all. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Update 05: Patch 01
notes.notes:
Hey destroyers!

Some of you have been reporting some issues on the Community Hub or our Discord server. We are really thankful for your patience and for helping us tracking these errors. Now it's time for a patch! It fixes some issues with controller and keyboard assignment on 2 player mode, frozen cutscenes and respawn errors, among other gameplay bug fixes.

If you find any other issue while playing Colossus Down, please, post it on the Technical issues subforum so we can help you with it as soon as possible.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 04: IT'S TIME
notes.notes:
Join forces with Nika, MechaNika, Agatha and the Great Bleeding Pig in Colossus Down, a unique and twisted mission of destruction of everything that isn't cool.

[previewyoutube=ooZmo73Fxa4;full][/previewyoutube]

Bringing this game to life has been quite a ride and we can't wait for you to discover our new Psychotic Adventure. We'd love to know what decisions you make and what outcomes you face throughout the game. Your experience, what you feel and what you think of it means a lot to us. So, please, feel free to share your thoughts about the game on social networks and leaving a review on Steam. That will help us A LOT!
